label: Casual leisure-activity verb phrases
explanation: It fires across verb phrases describing leisure actions in informal first-person/travel narratives ("take a picture", "sign your name", "have your breakfast"), so its top fired-on tokens are ordinary function words (" a", " the", " and") with ~0% conditional rates — the phrasal context, not any token, is the trigger. It is strongest on photography actions in travel writing ("photo-ops", "take our photo", "get some good photographs", "selfie-ing"), where it lights up the entire VP, and stays essentially silent in technical, legal, and code text, where only weak noise appears.
